SHARED PACK (pack-swan-front-01) — Sean-approved at the pack gate. All four compose from ONLY:
1. plate-swanwater — night hero
2. plate-crystal — ice texture
3. plate-proof — plan-vs-actual chart
4. plate-threshold — labeled SWANS.MP4 scrub placeholder
Brief: consult booking · all-comers · ONE threshold moment · 4 acts.

A · THE THRESHOLD — your Field Report DNA on the real page: side rail, split hero, calm acts; the swans go full-bleed exactly once, at the act 2-to-3 threshold.
TRADEOFF: the safest of the four — least likely to be remembered a week later.

B · WINGBEAT LEDGER — proof-first: the chart IS the hero, no video above the fold; the page earns the swans late.
TRADEOFF: cold open for a first-time visitor; asks them to care about data before they care about you.

C · SEASON ARC — a narrative in four seasons, chapter dots, no nav; threshold turns the season between Prove and Belong.
TRADEOFF: slowest route to the booking CTA; readers must want the story.

D · THE OBJECT (WILDCARD, alien: e-commerce PDP) — the consultation sold as a single luxury product: gallery, sticky buy-box, $175 visible immediately, specs, record.
TRADEOFF: boldest and most honest about money — may read as transactional to visitors who wanted to be courted.
